statement: Section8 follows the lines under the smoothing: the three simple lines persist and the24 lines coalesced along the tetrahedron edges separate into real lines for typeI, giving27.

answer.text: A smoothing realizes all27 lines as real.

source.version: Original Mathematische Annalen6(1873),551–581; GDZ article scan LOG_0040

scope: Nonsingular real cubic surfaces obtained by smoothing the real four-node cubic in Klein’s construction.
notes: The paragraph also displays15,7,3,3 for the other types. No chamber-connectedness result is catalogued from the historical deformation argument in this pass.
